chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: concerning

About a boy who steals, he said: “He is pardoned once. If he returns, his fingertips are cut, or they are scraped until they bleed. If he returns, his fingers are cut. If he returns, lower than that is cut.”

key_terms.ٱلصَّبِيِّ: a minor boy; the subject of the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a child who steals according to this hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a minor who commits theft, describing a graduated disciplinary response for repeated offenses. It reflects the jurisprudential treatment of recurring theft in the case of a child within the framework of Islamic penal law.
